notes.title: Early Access is over!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're proud to announce the Early Access of The Burning Descent is now over! Thanks a lot to our players for their continuing support and feedbacks during this period.
It's finally time for the game to have its full and final release, along with a bunch of cool new features and content.
Even with Early Access behind us, we'll always give the greater attention to your comments and feedbacks to always improve the game and try to give you the best experience possible.
We're still hard at work on the game and have a bunch of cool features upcoming soon, so stay tuned for incoming updates!
Thank you all for supporting the game and... enjoy!

[b]- New multiplayer map[/b]
A brand new 6-player multiplayer map was added. You can now fight your opponents on a total of 3 different arenas. We also added a map selector for you to easily pick your combat zone.

[b]- 2 New solo Time attack levels[/b]
'Inferno' and 'Kaboom' are added to train and test your skills even further! Try the ultimate challenge with the Grand Chelem mode where you will have to score the best time on each Time attack in a row. A worldwide ranking was implemented to see where you stand against the top players around the globe. 

[b]- Skins[/b]
You can now personalize your avatar with a pool of 3 different skins per character. This feature comes with a skin selector before starting the game.

[b]- 'Happy Hour'[/b]
You can now check ingame what are the best hours to find and compete connected players.

[b]- Random spawner for multiplayer sessions[/b]
Fighting opponents in TBD has never been easier now with the implementation of a new random spawner to join multiplayer sessions whenever you want.

[b]- A whole bunch of improvements, tweaks and polishing[/b]
A lot of work has been done to improve the overall player experience of TBD : rework of the ingame menu, improvement of the vocal communication tool in multiplayer, tweaking of the weapons' metrics and pick-ups.

[b]- Bug fixes[/b]
We polished the game thoroughly with more than a dozen of bug fixes.

notes.title: The Burning Descent patch note 22/01/2020
notes.content:
- minor bug fixes
- new Time Attack level added "Uncanny Canyon"
- implementation of a vocal communication tool in multiplayer
- Quality of Life: Improved weapon pickup system. It should now be easier and smoother to pickup weapons.
